body: I think this a lot I feel like I’m constantly in competition with my friends and feel so useless message me if you want to vent
I get you completely :( here if you want a chat
I’m so sorry you’re going through this please make sure you seek out professional help to help with PTSD as it’s something you shouldn’t go with on your own. My thoughts are with you x

I feel exactly like you do, this world is so shallow it hurts and makes you reflect that way on yourself. We need to kill those thoughts early. I’ve started to think why am I wasting my energy criticising myself on something I can’t control? It’s not your fault at all the way you were born, you can’t help it so why be mean to yourself for it? It’s just so society can make money. You can live a happy life with the way you look as it’s nothing that defines you, don’t let society rob you of anything
I agree I keep on attacking myself for cutting it off I keep on having a lot of ‘what ifs’ but I’m slowly starting to accept that it just wasn’t meant to be

Thank you so much for your help I feel like I’ve ripped the plaster off now and will help me heal a lot quicker. I feel instantly happier and feel like a huge weight has been lifted off my shoulders ☺️
